CheckTitle: Active Okta users have MFA enabled
Description: Ensure every active Okta user has at least one active MFA factor enrolled.
Risk: Okta users without MFA are more exposed to credential theft, phishing, and password reuse attacks.

Code.Other:
1. Enable strong authenticators such as Okta Verify, FastPass, or Passkeys.
2. Set at least one authenticator or factor to Required in enrollment policies.
3. Update global session and app sign-in policies to require MFA where appropriate.
4. Monitor enrollment status and prompt users who do not have MFA configured.

Recommendation.Text: Require MFA for active users and ensure users are enrolled in at least one usable authenticator.
